about: Redundant channels for every state that must never be confused (UI-03, NEW-11). Each state names what it uses on each channel. Colour is listed last and is never a deciding channel: remove it and every pair below must still differ on at least two other channels. HUD and actor engineers check their work against this file; docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md lists the gaps found in the current implementation.

channels.body: how the figure itself is drawn (fill, opacity, texture)
channels.ring: the floor ring under a self (its outline is the cassette shape: A circle, B triangle, C square, D plus)
channels.marker: an icon or mark above the head or attached to the figure
channels.word: the word shown on that cassette's HUD deck
channels.hud_icon: the icon next to the word (ui/hud/hud_icons.gd ids)
channels.audio: what the music layer does; reinforcement only, never the sole carrier

rule: Any two states in must_differ differ on at least two channels other than colour and audio, and at least one of those does not depend on motion (so a paused frame, a screenshot and the reduce-flashing option all still read).

actor_states.ring: solid cassette-shape ring, full opacity, letter badge
actor_states.marker: none (the self being recorded adds a bouncing chevron and a pulsing outer ring)
actor_states.colour: cassette colour on outline, ring, headphone glow

actor_states.means: the take being recorded right now, after its self died; the player still steers it
actor_states.body: translucent hologram (opacity about 0.55) with horizontal scanlines
actor_states.ring: dotted cassette-shape ring (round dots), letter badge
actor_states.motion: slow halo wobble, rising holo bits; scanlines scroll slowly

actor_states.means: a recorded tape replaying a self that died; inert, cannot act on the world
actor_states.body: hollow: no fill at all, only the rim
actor_states.ring: thin single-line cassette-shape ring at no less than 0.35 opacity, letter badge at no less than 0.6
actor_states.motion: replays its moves; trailing dust; no impact effects
actor_states.colour: grey; cassette colour survives only on ring and letter

actor_states.means: alive but desynchronised from its tape; a recovery spark is chasing it
actor_states.body: translucent (about 0.42), sliced into offset horizontal bands, doubled by a split echo
actor_states.ring: dashed cassette-shape ring, drawn twice with a small offset
actor_states.marker: dashed tether line from the figure to its spark; broken-link glyph above the head
actor_states.motion: irregular flicker (reduce-flashing: steady, bands drift slowly instead)

actor_states.means: the point that travels the recorded path to re-synchronise a desynced self
actor_states.body: not a figure: a small solid core in the cassette shape with a white-hot centre and an ink keyline
actor_states.outline: ink keyline around the core (paper + ink in high contrast)
actor_states.marker: the tether to its self; comet trail of shrinking copies of the cassette shape
actor_states.motion: travels along the path; pulses once per beat
actor_states.word: SPARK CHASING (part of the desynced badge); RESYNCED on arrival
actor_states.audio: rising tone as it closes in

actor_states.means: dodge invulnerability window on a living self
actor_states.body: opaque-to-translucent (0.3 / 0.85); never the sliced bands of a desync
actor_states.outline: continuous, switches to paper white for the window
actor_states.ring: unchanged solid ring (it is still an alive self)
actor_states.motion: fast, short (the length of the dodge); flicker (reduce-flashing: steady 0.6 opacity)
actor_states.word: none (transient; the dodge glyph is written on the ruler lane)

actor_states.means: a 'stop' tape reached its end; the self holds its last pose and is still solid
actor_states.marker: pause glyph (two bars) above the head
actor_states.motion: none at all: frozen; only the pause glyph breathes slowly

actor_combinations.rule: recording_ghost body, halo and dotted ring; add the tether, the broken-link glyph and the split echo
playback_ghost hollow body; add the tether and make the thin ring dashed
playback_ghost hollow body plus the pause glyph

by: body: filled hologram vs hollow rim
outline: thick cassette colour vs thin grey
body: scanlines vs sliced bands + echo
marker: halo vs tether + broken link
shape: cassette shape core vs elongated bolt

ring_line_styles.thin: playback_ghost (one third of the solid width, never below 2 px at 1080p)
ring_line_styles.dashed_double: desynced_projection (dash = gap = 1/16 of the perimeter, second copy offset 6 % of the radius)

deck_states.means: this cassette is not offered in the level
deck_states.shell: dark, diagonal hatch over the whole shell
dark shell with a dashed outline
deck_states.cassette: empty window: hubs only, no tape pack
deck_states.lane: empty lane between two dashed lines, text 'NOT RECORDED'

deck_states.means: selected and set up; the next count-in records it
deck_states.shell: active halo, paper frame and a tab reading SETTING UP / GET READY
deck_states.cassette: tape pack shown at the start
deck_states.lane: dashed outline preview of the tape's span

deck_states.shell: active halo, tab reading RECORDING with a lamp
deck_states.motion: lamp blinks at about 1.1 Hz (reduce-flashing: steady lamp); reels turn; lane fills
deck_states.lane: solid fill growing to a paper playhead
deck_states.colour: REC red on lamp and tab

deck_states.means: a finished take that is not committed yet
deck_states.cassette: diagonal hazard stripes across the label
round lock sticker on the corner

deck_states.means: a 'stop' tape has ended; the self holds its pose
deck_states.cassette: two pause bars between the reels
deck_states.lane: dashed hold line from a square end marker to the horizon, text 'HOLDS POSE'

deck_states.means: a 'repeat' tape on its second or later pass
deck_states.lane: hard ink cut at each pass boundary, forward arrows on later passes
turn notch at the boundary, backward arrows on the returning pass

deck_states.means: the self on this tape died
deck_states.word: DEAD - GHOST (DIED - RECORDING AS GHOST while still recording)
deck_states.cassette: grey tape pack; letter sticker keeps the cassette colour
deck_states.lane: death glyph at the beat, dead stretch drawn hollow from there

deck_states.means: the self is out of sync; a spark is chasing
deck_states.cassette: round desync sticker on the corner; offset bars across the cassette
deck_states.lane: desync glyph at the beat, stretch drawn dashed until the resync glyph

by: shell: dashed outline vs full hatch
lane: dashed preview vs solid fill
lane: hold line vs pass cuts
cassette: grey pack vs sticker + bars
cassette: grey pack vs pause bars

compact_deck_rule: A deck too small for all badge rows still shows, without colour: the status icon, the life icon when not alive, and the transport as reel direction plus chevrons or pause bars. The cinematic strip counts as a compact deck.
